actions.name: RagnarLocker ransomware encrypts files with extension .RGNR_<ID>
actions.description: RagnarLocker is identified by the extension “.RGNR_<ID>,” where <ID> is a hash of the computer’s NETBIOS name.

actions.name: RagnarLocker leaves a .txt ransom note
actions.description: The actors, identifying themselves as “RAGNAR_LOCKER,” leave a .txt ransom note, with instructions on how to pay the ransom and decrypt the data.

actions.name: RagnarLocker uses VMProtect, UPX, and custom packing algorithms
actions.description: RagnarLocker uses VMProtect, UPX, and custom packing algorithms and deploys within an attacker’s custom Windows XP virtual machine on a target’s site.

actions.name: RagnarLocker uses Windows API GetLocaleInfoW to identify victim location
actions.description: Ragnar Locker uses Windows API GetLocaleInfoW to identify the location of the infected machine. If the victim location is identified as certain countries, the process terminates.

actions.name: RagnarLocker checks for current infections to prevent multiple encryption
actions.description: The binary gathers the unique machine GUID, operating system product name, and user name currently running the process. This data is sent through a custom hashing algorithm to generate a unique identifier.

actions.name: RagnarLocker identifies all attached hard drives and assigns drive letters
actions.description: RagnarLocker identifies all attached hard drives using Windows APIs and assigns a drive letter to any volumes not assigned a logical drive letter, making them accessible for encryption.

actions.name: RagnarLocker terminates services used by managed service providers
actions.description: RagnarLocker iterates through all running services and terminates services commonly used by managed service providers to remotely administer networks.

actions.name: RagnarLocker deletes all Volume Shadow Copies silently
actions.description: The malware attempts to silently delete all Volume Shadow Copies, preventing user recovery of encrypted files, using two different methods: 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' and 'wmic.exe.shadowcopy.delete'.

actions.name: RagnarLocker encrypts all available files except those in excluded folders
actions.description: RagnarLocker encrypts all available files of interest but excludes certain folders such as Windows, Windows.old, Mozilla, Tor browser, Internet Explorer, $Recycle.Bin, Program Data, Google, Opera, and Opera Software.

actions.name: RagnarLocker excludes files with certain extensions from encryption
actions.description: When iterating through files, the malware does not encrypt files with extensions .db, .sys, .dll, .lnk, .msi, .drv, and .exe.
